import sys, random, time, itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from compiler import build_plan, verify_plan, find_cut

def mk(seed, n, nlinks, k, capmul, dmax, period=7):
    random.seed(seed)
    pairs=list(itertools.combinations(range(n),2)); random.shuffle(pairs)
    links=[(u,v,random.choice([1,2,5,10,50])) for (u,v) in pairs[:nlinks]]
    parts=sorted(random.sample(range(n),k))
    demand={v:0 for v in range(n)}
    for v in parts: demand[v]=random.choice([0,1,2,dmax])
    if sum(demand.values())==0: demand[parts[0]]=1
    linkuv=[(u,v) for (u,v,c) in links]
    cap=[period*c*capmul for (u,v,c) in links]
    return n, linkuv, cap, parts, demand

for (seed,n,nl,k,cm,dm) in [(1,48,128,32,50,5),(2,48,128,32,500,5),(3,20,60,10,20,3),(4,10,25,6,10,2),(5,48,120,20,200,3),(6,30,90,30,100,2)]:
    n,linkuv,cap,parts,demand = mk(seed,n,nl,k,cm,dm)
    t0=time.time(); plan=build_plan(n,linkuv,cap,parts,demand,randomized=False); t1=time.time()
    det = plan is not None
    cut=None
    if not det:
        t2=time.time(); cut=find_cut(n,linkuv,cap,parts,demand); t3=time.time()
        if cut is None:
            plan=build_plan(n,linkuv,cap,parts,demand,budget=12.0); t4=time.time()
            print(f"seed{seed} n{n} l{nl} k{k}: det={det} cut={'Y' if cut else 'N'} rand={'ok' if plan else 'NONE'} times det={t1-t0:.2f} cut={t3-t2:.2f} rand={t4-t3:.2f} trees={len(plan['trees']) if plan else 0} routes={len(plan['routes']) if plan else 0} recipes={len(plan['recipes']) if plan else 0} verify={verify_plan(plan,n,linkuv,cap,parts,demand) if plan else '-'}")
        else:
            print(f"seed{seed} n{n} l{nl} k{k}: det={det} cut=Y times det={t1-t0:.2f} cut={t3-t2:.2f}")
    else:
        print(f"seed{seed} n{n} l{nl} k{k}: det=True time={t1-t0:.2f}s trees={len(plan['trees'])} routes={len(plan['routes'])} recipes={len(plan['recipes'])} verify={verify_plan(plan,n,linkuv,cap,parts,demand)}")
PYEOF
